title: clinopodium chinense subsp. glabrescens
intro: Clinopodium chinense subsp. glabrescens, commonly known as Chinese Clinopodium, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium chinense subsp. glabrescens include analgesic, anti-febrile, and immune-modulating effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Clinopodium chinense subsp. glabrescens also include sesquiterpenes and phenolic glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
